documented_entry_commands.command: 新 worktree 先执行一次 `& $env:GODOT --headless --editor --path godot_csharp --import`。
| 解空间穷举、感知隔离、重演不改现实、回忆只影响本人 | `dotnet run --project godot_csharp/scenes/Awakening/check/ReplayCheck` | 编译游戏内同一份 `Night/*.cs`，跑 216 种组合；输出写入 `artifacts/remake-belief-replay/solution-space.txt` |

| 流程跳转回归 | `& $env:GODOT --headless --path godot_csharp --script res://scenes/Awakening/check/flow_check.gd` | 经 Main 标题页开始第一章，检查醒来、广播后公告框、门厅反转、协助/试验后的自动闪回、声路试验认知前置与真实听位、按检视认知开放答辩陈述、手印比对顺序、重演吻合、答辩与门开、对白后多按空格；同时检查低语和歇息入口不再出现。对白由脚本代推进 |
| 关键画面截图（开发自检） | `& $env:GODOT --path godot_csharp --script res://scenes/Awakening/check/state_gallery.gd` | 有窗口；PNG 写入 `artifacts/remake-belief-replay/gallery/` |
| `Script/chapter_01.story` + `Script/story/` | 两章对白、分支、证物事实与热点的唯一生产源。入口文件只写章节、按序 `引入：<相对路径或通配>` 与末尾的 `运行`（声明时长；模拟器 `--duration` 可代替或覆盖）；片段按生态、第一章、续篇分目录，按序引入与写在同一文件等价；每句台词行尾带 `[
| `Script/generated_awakening_*.json` / `Script/Chapter1CompiledDialogue.cs` | 由 `python godot_csharp/tools/compile_story.py` 生成；`--check` 检查一致性，不手工修改 |

controller_context_inheritance.reason: no child-context filtering or expectation denylist enforced by inspected verifier; independently spawned contexts must receive no expectations or route content

concurrency.note: timestamp/pid log directories reduce raw-log collisions; shared gallery and referenced user:// state are not demonstrated independent per run; no explicit mutex/file lock/access-control candidate in verifier

golden_approval.evidence_scope: tracked filename index, permitted README/csproj entry descriptions and tools/verify.py
golden_approval.note: absence is scope-limited; no golden created, sampled, updated or approved

fixed_route_policy.note: retain existing deterministic fixtures/routes for regression; they cannot establish independent gameplay or V02 autonomy

autonomous_controller_policy.note: view selection or scoring tokens alone do not establish autonomy, observability boundaries or expectation isolation

limitations: bounded first batch; not exhaustive semantic oracle audit
pattern hits may include generic diagnostics, fixture declarations or non-controller code; values deliberately not read out
no design or .story contents, no solutions or historical play contents inspected
no OS ACL/process isolation audit or enforcement performed
all acceptance levels remain unverified; this is inventory only
